The site is Aether Audio — Aether One Planar Magnetic Headphone Launch & Pre-Order, a scroll-storytelling-launch web application for Aether Audio Aether One planar magnetic headphone launch and pre-order.

Owner brief: "Our acoustic engineering studio, Aether Audio, is launching the Aether One open-back planar magnetic headphones and needs a scroll-driven product launch and pre-order site. Visitors should be able to step through the acoustic architecture chapters, compare finishes and ear-pad materials, and submit a pre-order reservation that persists on the server and remains visible after reloading the confirmation page."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-31/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Aether Audio — Aether One Planar Magnetic Headphone Launch & Pre-Order: the page for Aether Audio Aether One planar magnetic headphone launch and pre-order, in a dark, low-glare palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #14110f (ae-bg), #1f1a17 (ae-surface), #29221e (ae-card), #3d332c (ae-border), #d97706 (ae-copper), #f59e0b (ae-gold), #fafaf9 (ae-text), #a8a29e (ae-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 6px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--ae-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a scroll animation that blocks reading or ignores reduced-motion preference; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Full name", "Confirmation email", "Chassis finish", "Ear-pad material", "Headband engraving note").

User journey context: Explore the sticky chapter navigation, exploded planar driver anatomy, and acoustic specifications. Select a milled chassis finish and ear-pad material, enter buyer contact details, and submit a pre-order.
